name: GaugeCalibrationRegister
tagline: Gauge register, calibration recall and out-of-tolerance impact assessment for Power Platform
description: A PCF control for quality and metrology teams: register every gauge and instrument, see what is due or overdue, record calibrations with as-found/as-left results, control quarantine and gauge-crib issue, track GR&R and assess every lot measured with an out-of-tolerance gauge.
features: Status engine: in service, due soon, overdue, out of tolerance, quarantined, out for calibration
KPI strip incl. on-time calibration % and GR&R above limit
Record calibration dialog with tolerance validation and automatic next-due recalculation
Quarantine, send to lab, issue/return with automatic issue blocking
Recall plan by week with workload chart and in-house/external split
OOT impact assessment with per-lot decisions, justification and close
Deviation chart against the tolerance band and full calibration history
Phone card layout, keyboard operation, configurable labels and colours
